097_prezidentas.note: Main picture: a man president at a podium draped with the tricolour speaking toward the hall with a raised hand, near-frontal — a tall trim man in his seventies with grey-white hair combed straight back, a broad open face and a warm closed-mouth smile, no spectacles, in a grey suit and tie; on the wall behind the podium, drawn large, clean and simple, the Vytis — a white armoured knight on a white rearing horse, sword raised, on a red field; beside him a woman president seated at a side table signing a document, head bent to the page. Insets: the president shaking a hand before a crowd; the tricolour on a flagpole before a heavy neoclassical building with an arcaded entrance; a motorcade with small flags.

106_zaidejas.note: Main picture: a man and a woman player in plain jerseys and shorts on a grass pitch ringed by a cinder track, a low covered wooden grandstand and tall oaks behind, one dribbling the ball, the other running alongside; one glances toward the viewer. Insets: a basketball player shooting at a hoop; a chess player moving a piece; a volleyball player at the net.

107_sirgalius.note: A man and a woman spectator in the covered wooden grandstand of a stadium holding a tricolour scarf up with both hands and shouting, the oak tops of a park showing past the stand's roof; one faces the viewer, the other looks at the pitch. Insets: the grass pitch and cinder track from the stand; a rattle and a scarf; a crowd of spectators.

055_bankas.note: Main picture: a bank hall under a great triangular glass skylight, black marble columns and a coffered ceiling behind — a cashier seen full-face through a counter grille, the grille clearly in front of her with the counter ledge below it, counting banknotes onto the ledge for a customer standing on the near side; the counter with its grille is the subject. Insets: the bank's pale neoclassical corner front with its tall columned entrance; a savings book stamped; coins stacked on the counter.

413_tuoktis.note: A couple exchanging rings before a registry official at a desk: the groom slides a gold ring onto the bride's ring finger - his right hand holds the ring, her left hand is held out flat and still, palm down, fingers slightly apart; only these two hands meet and every finger is clear; both look at the ring; the official faces the viewer. Insets: a pair of gold rings in an open ring box; the couple signing the register with plain strokes; guests throwing grain.

A2-1326.note: Main picture: a postman in a uniform cap with a bulging shoulder bag handing letters to a woman at her garden gate, his bicycle leaning on the fence. The man delivering letters is the subject. Insets: the postman leaving the post office front - a smooth pale flat-roofed modernist block with very large windows in carved wooden frames and a round clock; the bag full of envelopes; the postman on his bicycle.

A2-0085.note: Main picture: a small window in the tiled wall of a tall station hall with square pilasters and a coffered ceiling, a woman clerk behind the glass handing a ticket and change across, a traveller with a suitcase receiving it, two people queued behind. The window with the exchange of ticket and money is the subject. Insets: a punched ticket; the brass window counter with coins; the queue seen from behind under the high hall.

A2-0660.note: Main picture: a zebra crossing seen at an angle - bold white stripes across the asphalt, a mother and child and a man crossing on them, the child holding the strap of the mother's handbag, a Zhiguli stopped at the line, a crossing sign post. The striped crossing with people on it is the subject. Insets: the pedestrian signal light with only the green walking figure lit; a child's shoes stopping at the white kerb line; the stripes from above.

A2-1431.note: Main picture: a man in a clothes shop trying on a new jacket: he has one arm in its sleeve and is pulling it on over his shoulder while the assistant, a tape measure round her neck, holds the jacket up for him from behind; a second jacket hangs on the rail; no mirror anywhere in the picture. The garment being tried for size is the subject. Insets: a foot pushed into a new shoe with a shoehorn; a man trying on a hat, adjusting its brim with one hand, seen from the front, no mirror; a tape measure around a waist.

A2-1360.note: Main picture: a theatre — actors in period costume on a lit stage before a painted backdrop, footlights, the red curtain half drawn, tiered boxes in red velvet and gilt along the walls, rows of audience in the dark. The acted scene on the stage is the subject. Insets: a playbill frame left blank; an actor bowing; opera glasses.

A2-0649.note: Main picture: a post office hall — a tall wide room whose tiled floor is patterned like a woven linen towel, a row of brass-railed counters with clerks behind glass, a woman weighing a parcel on a letter scale, a man licking a stamp, sacks of mail, a blue post box by the door. The counters with letters and parcels are the subject. Insets: the post office front — a smooth pale flat-roofed modernist block with very large windows in carved wooden frames and a round clock; a postman's bicycle with bags; a bundle of letters tied with string.
